name: schierami
description: Rule-aware fantasy soccer lineup assistant for Classic, Mantra, and custom leagues.

interface.shortDescription: Rule-aware fantasy soccer lineup and bench advice
interface.longDescription: Schierami combines your roster, actual league rules, current football evidence, and deterministic optimization to recommend legal lineups, bench order, captain choices, and close-call decisions without assuming one platform or scoring preset.
defaultPrompt: Here is my roster. What lineup and bench should I use this matchday?
Who should I start between these players under my league rules?
Check the current availability and rule-sensitive risks in my lineup.
